name: delta-exchange-mcp
description: Live market data and your Delta Exchange India account.
long_description:
Ask about Delta Exchange India in plain English: live prices, option chains, order books, funding and open-interest history, plus your own positions, orders, fills and balances.

**Market data needs no account connection.** Account calls open a short-lived browser page when a connection is missing. Enter the API key and secret there. They do not pass through the conversation or an MCP tool call. When available, the server stores them in macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, or Linux Secret Service. Otherwise it keeps the connection and trading consent in process memory for that process. The server does not use a plaintext fallback.

**Trading needs separate browser approval.** Trading tools stay visible so clients keep one stable tool list. A dry run sends no mutation and needs no trading approval. A real trading call opens the approval page when approval is missing. Approval does not execute the pending trade. Submit a new call if the trade is still wanted.

Production trading can place real orders with no size cap. Orders are sized in contracts, not coins. The approval page requires a separate production acknowledgement. By default, every real mutation is written to an owner-only audit log.

tools.description: Bulk-export your fills to a CSV file on disk.

tools.name: cancel_all_orders
tools.description: Cancel open orders. WARNING: with no filters this cancels ALL of your open orders.

tools.name: cancel_batch_orders
tools.description: Cancel up to 50 orders on one contract in a single request.

tools.name: cancel_order
tools.description: Cancel a single order by id or client_order_id.

tools.name: close_all_positions
tools.description: Close open positions in the scopes you set to true. Both flags default to false,

tools.name: configure_auto_topup
tools.description: Override auto top-up for a single position (otherwise inherits the account setting).

tools.name: edit_batch_orders
tools.description: Edit up to 50 orders on one contract in a single request.

tools.name: edit_bracket_order
tools.description: Edit the bracket (TP/SL) params on an existing order.

tools.name: edit_order
tools.description: Edit an open order. Pass exactly one of product_id or product_symbol.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: OHLC candles. For funding/mark/OI history prefer the dedicated tools

tools.name: get_connection_status
tools.description: Report connection and trading state without returning credential material.

tools.name: get_debug_status
tools.description: Report whether debug logging is on and where its log is stored.

tools.name: get_fills
tools.description: Your trade fills (executed trades). Paginated. Timestamps are microseconds.

tools.name: get_funding_history
tools.description: Historical funding rate candles for a perpetual.

tools.name: get_indices
tools.description: Spot price indices that Delta builds by combining prices from prominent exchanges.

tools.name: get_margined_positions
tools.description: All open margined positions, optionally filtered.

tools.name: get_mark_price_history
tools.description: Historical mark-price candles for a product.

tools.name: get_oi_history
tools.description: Historical open-interest candles for a product.

tools.name: get_open_orders
tools.description: Current open/pending orders. Paginated via meta.after / meta.before.

tools.name: get_options_chain
tools.description: Options chain (all call+put tickers) for one underlying on one expiry.

tools.name: get_order_by_id
tools.description: Fetch a single order by id or client_order_id. Exactly one must be provided.

tools.name: get_order_history

tools.name: get_orderbook

tools.name: get_product_leverage
tools.description: Configured order leverage for a product.

tools.name: get_recent_trades
tools.description: Recent public trades for a symbol.

tools.name: get_reference_data
tools.description: Merged assets + indices listing — useful for symbol/asset metadata lookups.

tools.name: get_settlement_prices
tools.description: Historical settlement prices for expired/settled derivatives.

tools.name: get_ticker
tools.description: Get 24h ticker (price, volume, OI, mark/spot) for one symbol.

tools.name: get_trading_preferences
tools.description: User trading preferences (margin mode, notifications, etc.).

tools.name: get_trading_stats
tools.description: Account-level trading volume / stats.

tools.name: get_trading_status

tools.name: get_wallet_balances
tools.description: Wallet balances across all assets.

tools.name: get_wallet_transactions
tools.description: Wallet transaction history. Paginated. Timestamps are microseconds.

tools.description: Attach a take-profit / stop-loss bracket to a position. Provide at least one leg.
